# hyperlite_network_reservation (Resource)

A DHCP reservation of a NAT or isolated network: the address a MAC address always gets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hyperlite_network_reservation" "web" {
  network = hyperlite_network.lan.name
  mac     = hyperlite_vm.web.network_interface[0].mac
  ip      = "10.0.20.50"
  name    = "web-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The address it gets.
- `mac` (String) The MAC address (a `hyperlite_vm`'s `network_interface.N.mac`).
- `network` (String) The network.

### Optional

- `name` (String) A host name given with it.
- `node` (String) The member of the cluster the reservation's network is on (absent: the node the provider talks to). Another member makes it again there.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<network>/<mac>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By `<network>/<mac>`; the same led by `<node>/` for one on another node of the cluster.
terraform import hyperlite_network_reservation.web lan/52:54:00:12:34:56
terraform import hyperlite_network_reservation.web pve-b/lan/52:54:00:12:34:56
```
